title: Construction of a Primary School and Sports Hall
raw_text: The Municipality of Eastbrook invites tenders for the design and construction of a two-storey primary school for 420 pupils with an attached sports hall. Works include site clearance, a reinforced concrete frame, masonry, roofing, mechanical and electrical installations and landscaping. The contractor must hold a valid building licence, provide a ten-year structural warranty and complete the works within 18 months of contract signature. Site safety must comply with national construction regulations.
requirements: Design and construction of a two-storey primary school for 420 pupils
Reinforced concrete frame, masonry and roofing
Valid building licence and ten-year structural warranty
Completion within 18 months of contract signature
